name: Crate Pushers
hook: Push every crate onto its pad. Steel takes two.
how: Walk into a crate to push it and get every crate onto a matching pad. Steel crates only move when two of you line up behind and push together. Stuck? Vote to undo the last push or reset the level. Five hand-made levels.
controls: Arrow keys or WASD, Z to undo, R to reset; on touch, the D-pad or drag on the level
uses: The host's browser moves the crates and checks who is pushing; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Alone? A buddy bot pushes wood crates, backs you up on steel ones and asks for a hand.
The fastest crew through all five levels.
Everyone walks, pushes and votes in the same warehouse.
